nodes.summary:
usage: corvint-corpus-mcp --root ROOT --artifact ARTIFACT [--map FILE]... [--consolidation] [--legacy-cases]
           [--outcome-log FILE] [--protocol-version 2026-07-28|2025-11-25]
       corvint-corpus-mcp --outcome-summary LOG [--floor FLOOR]
       corvint-corpus-mcp --version
A local read-only stdio MCP server for the documentation corpus ARTIFACT of the Git worktree at ROOT.
Deprecated alias for the corpus tools, kept for one release:
corvint-mcp --root ROOT --tool-profile corpus --corpus-artifact ARTIFACT serves the same corpus tools
with the same results; --map, --consolidation, --legacy-cases and --outcome-log stay here.
Example: corvint-corpus-mcp --root /absolute/repo --artifact corpus.json
Show command help or the offline machine catalog.
